title: How Tesla Really Makes Money (Some of It Comes From Its Rivals)
description:
Tesla brought in $94.8 billion in 2025, yet some of its most profitable money came from other car makers. In this file we open the money machine behind Tesla: two engineers and a Lotus-based Roadster, the 'secret master plan', the 2008 brush with bankruptcy, the $42 million Fremont factory, the Model 3 and Model Y, the billions from selling clean-car credits to rivals, where the money comes from today, and the giant bet on Full Self-Driving, robotaxis and Optimus robots, with the latest numbers.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: Tesla Q3 2026 vehicle production, deliveries and deployments release (SEC filing, October 2026); Electrek (Tesla Q3 2026 financial results, October 2026); Just Auto / Yahoo Finance (Tesla 2025 results); Energy-Storage.news (February 2026); TechCrunch (Tesla Q4 2025 earnings); CarbonCredits.com (Tesla credit revenue 2024); Marketplace (how government credits support EV makers); JATO Dynamics (best-selling vehicle of 2023); Fortune / AP (Austin robotaxi launch, June 2025); Wikipedia (History of Tesla, Inc.; Tesla Fremont Factory).

All figures are rounded. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
